valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD listing (NASDAQ), no ADR conversion, so per-share values are on the same basis as the close. Anchor: reported GAAP diluted EPS of $1.68 (Q1 2026), $2.14 (Q2), $2.62 (Q3), plus Q4 2026 guidance midpoint $2.62 (range $2.45-$2.79) gives about $9.06 for FY2026. Management gave no 2027 outlook in the Q3 release and the release reports no non-GAAP EPS. FY2027 EPS of $11.00 (about +21%) is my own assumption: Q3 revenue was up 28% year over year, and the Q4 guide holds near the Q3 run-rate of $2.62 per quarter (about $10.50 annualized), with modest growth on top. Diluted shares about 921M (Q3 2026). Dividend excluded (price-only); the Q3 release cites $1.42 quarterly declared, but a secondary source shows a higher $6.08 annual rate, so the dividend is not netted in.

bear.driver: Analog cycle peaks in 2026: Q4 seasonal weakness, back-end tool lead times and supply limits cap volume, and the market treats Q3 margins (gross margin 64.2%) as peak-level. EPS falls back below the FY2026 level.

base.driver: Industrial, automotive and data-center demand keeps revenue growing in the mid-teens and operating leverage lifts EPS about 21% from FY2026, with the multiple near the level of recent quarters.

bull.driver: Restocking and data-center demand sustain above-seasonal growth into 2027, incremental margins stay high and the market pays a premium multiple for the cycle upturn.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $11.00 the $303.60 close implies 27.6x. The unweighted average of the four post-Q3 named price targets ($310; 4 calls, no horizon documented) implies about 28.2x at $11.00, or about $11.07 EPS at 28x. The analyst-weighted target is not computed because no horizon is documented for these calls.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $11.00 (about 3.6 pp of the close). A $1.00 change in FY2027 EPS at 28x moves the base target by $28 (about 9 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Gross margin (Q3 2026: 64.2%) and revenue against the Q4 2026 guide of $5.80B-$6.30B, and the Q1 2027 outlook: a Q1 2027 revenue and EPS guide that implies a sequential EPS step-up above $2.62 would support the base case. A guide that falls back toward the $2.23-$2.57 range seen in Q3 guidance would weaken it.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and full-year 2026 results with the Q1 2027 outlook, expected late January 2027 (date not confirmed in sources).

analyst_notes: Four named post-Q3 price-target calls (Bernstein $310, DZ Bank $300, Wells Fargo $300, Freedom Capital $330; unweighted mean $310) sit about 2% above the close and about the base case ($308). Freedom raised from $260 and Bernstein from $290; Wells Fargo and DZ Bank hold at $300 with Hold ratings, so the post-earnings revisions are mixed. Bank of America reaffirmed Buy on Nov 10 without a published target. Earlier July 2026 calls (JPMorgan, KeyBanc, Rosenblatt, Benchmark, TD Cowen, Arete) were visible in secondary sources but their analyst names were not verified, so they are excluded. The aggregate Street mean in August was about $325 (source page dates vary), which is above the base case; the gap is roughly 5% of the close and implies either a higher FY2027 EPS (about $11.70 at 28x) or a higher multiple (about 29.5x at $11.00).
